summary: Caring Brands, Inc., a Nevada-based cosmetics registrant trading on Nasdaq as CABR, filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing two related items. First, on September 3, 2026, the company entered a one-year Consulting Services Agreement with Myall Luna Ventures Inc., paying $10,000 monthly in advance, terminable on 30 days' notice without automatic renewal. Second, the board appointed Myall Luna's president, Brian R. Meadows, as an independent director effective September 4, 2026. Both events are routine personnel and service-contract matters, not a reportable special situation. Watch for any related-party concerns given Meadows' dual roles.
